premises.text: Presentation work is fragmented across PowerPoint, email, Slack, Drive/Dropbox, and separate sharing/presenting tools, causing version and formatting failures
premises.evidence_span: people are creating their presentation in PowerPoint, sharing it via email, having a conversation about it on Slack

premises.text: Slides is an end-to-end cloud platform for creating, presenting, and sharing with a stacked-slide format and collaborative customizable editor
premises.evidence_span: Slides is an end-to-end platform for creating, presenting, and sharing presentations

premises.text: Offerings include free signup plus individual/team plans and Enterprise deployment behind the corporate firewall
premises.evidence_span: we just started rolling out Slides for Enterprise, which takes our product and puts it behind the corporate firewall

value.text: Easy collaborative work on better presentations
value.evidence_span: We make it easy to work together on presentations

causal_links.evidence_span: changed the way teams work together on presentations
We offer plans for individuals and teams

notes: Live embeds, stacked details, comments, team templates, media library, live/offline/link present, and mobile rendering folded as cascade of one end-to-end platform (§4.1.7).
